# LinkedIn Authority Post — Customer Health Score & Explainability HUD

Most companies lose 15–30% of their revenue not because of bad marketing, but because of silent workflow breakdowns.

We built **Customer Health Score & Explainability HUD** to solve this exact problem:
Weighted multi-factor retention engine that scores account viability across usage, support sentiment, invoice promptness, and sponsor engagement with full audit explainability.

### The Sentinel Claim Audit Registry
* **Benchmark Scenario:** Evaluated against synthetic multi-factor telemetry.
* **Demonstrated Latency:** Sub-millisecond calculation in zero-dependency Node.js runtime.
* **Live In-Browser Sandbox:** https://gideonbawa-website.netlify.app/simulators/customer-health-score/
* **Source Code:** https://github.com/bawagideon/customer-health-score
